flags.caption:
Milestones aren't just about numbers. They're about showing up when it's hard, choosing consistency over excuses, and becoming a little stronger every single day.

This week we're celebrating every member who hit a new milestone. Whether it's your first class, your 100th, a new PR, or simply walking through our doors when you didn't feel like it,you earned it. We're incredibly proud of you.

We also want to give a huge shoutout to our own Manager Meg, who stepped on the NPC bikini stage this past weekend alongside her husband. After months of balancing work, family, coaching, and relentless dedication, they both brought home placements in their divisions. 🎉💪

At SWEAT440, we believe in practicing what we preach. Our coaches and managers aren't just telling you to trust the process…they're living it.

Congratulations to every member and every milestone, big or small. Keep showing up. The best is still ahead. ❤️🔥
flags.why: Caption: celebrates member milestones and also shouts out Manager Meg competing on the NPC bikini stage — physique-competition posing in a competition suit sits outside the athletic-bodies-and-gym-wear norm the framework treats as standard, though the reference alone is not a violation. Visual analysis: the cover is a member holding an official Ocean Township 440 Sweat Club shield in the studio, fully clean; any stage photos would sit on interior carousel slides not reachable from the cover.
flags.action: Open the carousel and review interior slides for competition-stage imagery. If stage photos are present, judge against the fitness-norms line; if the post is milestone photos only and the NPC mention is text, dismiss.

flags.caption:
SWEAT440 Old Bridge x Alliance Orthopedics: Building a Healthier Community Together

At SWEAT440 Old Bridge, our mission has always been bigger than fitness—it's about building a healthier, stronger community. That's why we're excited to partner with Alliance Orthopedics, one of New Jersey's leading providers of orthopedic care, sports medicine, rehabilitation, and recovery.

Alliance Orthopedics offers a comprehensive approach to health and wellness, bringing together orthopedic specialists, sports medicine physicians, physical therapy, occupational therapy, chiropractic care, pain management, recovery and rehabilitation, spine care, joint and extremity care, foot and ankle specialists, shockwave therapy, and more—all under one roof. Their team is dedicated to helping people recover from injuries, relieve pain, restore mobility, and return to doing what they love. (Alliance Orthopedics)

Through this collaboration, our community will have access to expert recovery resources that complement the high-energy workouts at SWEAT440. Whether you're recovering from an injury, preventing future injuries, improving mobility, or simply striving to live a healthier lifestyle, Alliance Orthopedics is committed to supporting your journey every step of the way.

Together, SWEAT440 and Alliance Orthopedics are creating more than workouts—we're creating a community built on fitness, health, recovery, education, and long-term wellness. We can't wait to bring exciting events, recovery experiences, and wellness initiatives to the Old Bridge community.

Train hard. Recover smarter. Live healthier. Together.
flags.why: Caption: announces a formal partnership with Alliance Orthopedics, a third-party medical provider — orthopedic specialists, sports medicine physicians, physical therapy, chiropractic care, pain management and spine care are all named — which is the exact scenario Category 6 calls out. The copy also contains a stray source artifact, a parenthetical "(Alliance Orthopedics)" mid-paragraph, suggesting text lifted from an external source without editing. Visual analysis: cover frame is a coach speaking to camera in an official SWEAT440 quarter-zip with the mark unmodified; no co-branded artwork on the cover, so Category 5 is clean.
flags.action: Confirm the Alliance Orthopedics partnership has documented franchise approval before anything further publishes — medical-provider tie-ins carry liability and scope-of-practice exposure beyond normal partnerships. Also ask Old Bridge to clean the stray "(Alliance Orthopedics)" citation artifact from the live caption.

flags.caption: Swing By the Studio This Sunday!!!
flags.why: Visual analysis: the flyer renders the studio name as "SWEAT 440 DR PHILLIPS" with a space between SWEAT and 440, in the #00FFC2 accent green rather than standard treatment; brand guidelines specify the name as SWEAT440, all caps, no spaces. The official horizontal lockup at the top of the flyer is correct and unmodified, and all colors used are in-palette. Caption: "Swing By the Studio This Sunday!!!" — seven words, no studio name, no date, no address, all of which live only in the image.
flags.action: Quick glance to confirm or dismiss — the mark itself is correct, so this is a wordmark-formatting question, not logo misuse. If SWEAT440 enforces the no-space rule on typeset studio names, flag to Dr Phillips for future assets.

flags.action: Ask South Beach to replace the asset with the placeholder text removed — this is a production QA miss rather than a policy breach, but it is live and visible. Also reconcile the four tagged coaches against the six shown.
